title: Master panel
staleTransfers: Bank transfers for plans have been waiting for confirmation for more than 3 days: {count}. Check the statement — the invoice is due within 5 days of receiving the payment (Art. 113(4) VAT Act).
chainOk: The chain is intact: {count} documents, every fingerprint and seal matches.
chainBroken: The chain breaks at link no. {at} ({kind}).
featuresHelp: A disabled feature is offered nowhere, whatever the plan.

integration.title: Integrations
integration.intro: Keys are stored encrypted and never shown back — you only see the last 4 characters. An empty field keeps the saved value. Values set here take precedence over the server .env.

checkErrors.unauthorized: Revolut rejected the key (401/403). Make sure it is the Secret key for the selected environment.
checkErrors.missingKey: No Secret API key is saved.
checkErrors.network: The server could not be reached.
checkErrors.smtp: The SMTP server refused the connection.
checkErrors.tlsOnPlainPort: This port does not start with TLS (2525 and 587 upgrade to TLS with STARTTLS). Untick “TLS from the start” — it is for port 465 only — save and check again.
checkErrors.plainOnTlsPort: Port 465 starts with TLS right away. Tick “TLS from the start” or change the port to 2525 or 587.
checkErrors.noAuth: The server accepted the connection, but the email went out without signing in (“authenticate first”). Re-enter the SMTP key from Brevo → SMTP & API → SMTP (an “xsmtpsib-…” key, not an “xkeysib-…” API key) and its login, save and check again.
checkErrors.missingCredentials: No login or SMTP key is saved — fill in both and save.
checkErrors.unreadableSecret: The saved key cannot be read (server key changed or damaged record) — enter the SMTP key again and save.

errors.invalidPort: The port is a number from 1 to 65535.
errors.invalidFrom: The sender is “Name <address>” or just an address.
errors.invalidSecret: The key is at least 8 characters, no spaces.
errors.invalidWebhookSecret: The webhook secret starts with wsk_.
errors.reenterSecret: The saved key cannot be read — enter it again or tick “Delete”.

integration.checkSmtp: Check and send a test email to {email}
integration.unreadable: The saved keys cannot be read (damaged record or a changed LEDGER_SEAL_KEY). Enter them again or delete them explicitly.

transfer.title: Transfer to the owner
transfer.intro: The company has no owner — it was added by an accounting firm or its ownership was revoked. Check a proof of representation (current Commercial Register extract or a power of attorney), then send an invitation to the representative’s email. They take over the profile with one link; firms’ mandates stay pending or active as they are.
transfer.checked: I have checked the proof of representation.
transfer.sent: The invitation to {email} for {company} is valid until {date}.
transfer.mailQueued: The email is queued and leaves within a minute.
transfer.mailNotReady: Email is not configured yet — the message is waiting. You can also send the link yourself.
transfer.linkOnce: Shown only now — the database keeps only its fingerprint. A new invitation revokes this one.

errors.notChecked: Tick that you have checked the proof of representation.
errors.hasOwner: The company already has an owner.
errors.invalid: The invitation is no longer open.

ownership.reviewTitle: To review: owners invited by an accounting firm
ownership.reviewHelp: An accounting firm invited the owner of a company it added itself. Check that this person really represents the company: “Owner verified” removes it from the list, “Revoke ownership” — in a dispute (the firm then cannot invite until you invite an owner with “Transfer”).
ownership.title: Revoke ownership
ownership.intro: In a dispute (for example, the firm invited its own second email): the owner and all members lose access, active mandates become pending, open invitations are revoked and the company becomes unverified. Issued documents stay. Then invite the real owner with “Transfer”.
ownership.understood: I understand: the owner and members lose access to the company.
ownership.done: Ownership is revoked. Invite the real owner with “Transfer” below.

errors.notUnderstood: Tick that you understand the consequences.
errors.notCompany: An accounting firm’s ownership is not revoked here.

paidOnHelp: The tax point of the invoice (BT-7). The Carbon Stealth invoice is issued at once, into the client’s inbox.

paymentCheck.help: Card payment with no notice from Revolut: the order is read from Revolut and checked (amount, currency, reference). If paid, it is activated with an invoice.
paymentCheck.activated: Paid — the plan is active and the invoice issued.
paymentCheck.notPaid: The order is not paid at Revolut yet.
paymentCheck.notFound: No such order on our side.
paymentCheck.mismatch: The Revolut order does not match the record (amount, currency or reference) — not activated; see the audit log.
paymentCheck.revolut-notConfigured: Revolut is not set up (Settings → Revolut).
paymentCheck.revolut-rejected: Revolut refused the request (key or environment).
paymentCheck.revolut-network: No connection to Revolut — try again.
paymentCheck.review: Paid but not activated: the Revolut amount does not match or the order was superseded by a newer paid plan. See the audit log and refund through Revolut.
paymentCheck.billing-needsReview: The order was superseded by a newer paid plan — not activated. Decide manually (refund).
paymentCheck.billing-creditStale: The order deducts a subscription that is no longer the active one (replaced or expired before payment) — not activated. Decide manually (refund or a new order).
paymentCheck.billing-noSupplier: The supplier company is not set (Settings → billing.supplierOrgId) or has no default series.
paymentCheck.billing-amountMismatch: The amount does not match the order.

masterRole.title: Masters
masterRole.help: Masters have full access to the panel. Every grant and revocation is confirmed with the code from your two-factor app; the other masters receive an email and the action is in the audit log. The last master cannot be removed.
masterRole.name: Name
masterRole.codeFor: Code from the app to revoke the role of {email}
masterRole.codeHint: six digits from your two-factor app

ok.granted: The role is granted; the account signs in again and enables two-factor sign-in.
ok.created: The account is created with the master role; we sent a password link (1 hour; then use “Forgot password”).

err.invalid: Check the email and the code.
err.badCode: The code is wrong or already used — wait for the next one.
err.already: The account is already a master.
err.notMaster: The account is not a master.
err.lastMaster: This is the last master — grant the role to someone else first.
err.nameRequired: Enter a name for a new account.
